contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A question, an idea, or something that should not be here? Send an email to the address on this page.
contact.intro: Printopoly is a hobby project. A question, an idea, or a mistake you found? Send an email.
contact.abuse_title: Report something that shouldn't be here
contact.abuse_body: Did you see something that isn't allowed, such as a photo of yourself that you never agreed to? Email the same address and say what you see and where. The terms have more.
contact.security_body: Email it to this address. The address is also in our security.txt.
edition.name: Name
edition.intro: Pick a starting point or begin blank. You can change everything below later by clicking the name in the editor.
edition.part_note.deeds: needed if you change street names
edition.part_note.cards: two decks of cards with your own text
edition.part_note.houseRules: a sheet with your own rules
edition.part_note.rulesBooklet: a booklet with the rules and the prices of your board
edition.part_note.invitation: a card to invite your friends
edition.parts_hint: What you don't choose, you skip: it won't be in the editor or in the print set. You can add it later. For what you skip, just use the parts from your own box.
edition.profile_standard_note: about 500 × 500 mm · folds in four · box lid about 267 × 267 mm
edition.profile_custom_note: For an older or different board. You measure it with a ruler.
edition.profile_fits: A regular space is :width mm wide.

editions.delete_body_account: This edition is in your account and in this browser. If you delete it, it's gone everywhere and this can't be undone.

editor.name: Name
editor.card_text_insert_hint: Pick a space or an amount. The text follows the name when you rename the space.
editor.card_text_insert_hint_names: Pick a space or the currency. The text follows the name when you rename the space.
editor.card_text_hint: Names of spaces are variables: they follow a rename. Use Insert to place one.
editor.photo_optional_hint: A photo is optional: without one, the space shows text only. You can also drag a photo here.
editor.town_hint: Applies to every street in this colour group (:group), on the board and on the title deeds. Leave empty to show no town.
editor.photo_drop_hint: Drag a photo here, or choose one. You can choose several at once.
editor.photo_paste_hint: You can also paste: copy a photo and press :keys.
editor.paste_none: There is no photo on the clipboard. Copy a photo first.
editor.paste_no_place: This element has no photo frame. Choose a space or card with one.
editor.paste_denied: The browser did not allow access to the clipboard. Press the paste keys instead of the button.
editor.photo_frame_label: Photo, arrows move, plus and minus zoom
editor.photo_storage_full: no longer fits in the storage of this browser. Delete a photo or an edition, or log in with Google.
editor.swap_hint: Drag a space onto one of the same kind, or press W.
editor.swap_done: :a and :b swapped. Price and colour belong to the spot.
editor.swap_dragging: :name is being dragged. Drop it on a space of the same kind.
editor.swap_pick: Swap :name with another space: Enter confirms, Esc cancels.
editor.swap_not_allowed: You can only swap streets with streets, stations with stations and utilities with utilities.
editor.photos_skipped: Skipped: :count spaces without room for a photo, such as Chance, Community Chest and tax.
editor.photos_leftover: :count photos did not fit: there were no spaces left.
auth.logout_note: When you log out we clear the copy in this browser; your editions stay in your account. Handy on a shared computer.
auth.logout_failed: Logging out didn't work. Try again.
auth.delete_body: Your account, your editions and your photos on the server are deleted and this can't be undone. To confirm, type your e-mail address (:email).
auth.delete_wrong_email: That isn't the e-mail address of this account.
auth.delete_failed: The account could not be deleted. Try again.
sync.imported: {1} :count edition is now in your account.|[2,*] :count editions are now in your account.
sync.conflicts: {1} :count edition is already in your account with another version. We didn't overwrite it.|[2,*] :count editions are already in your account with another version. We didn't overwrite them.

sync.problem_login: You were logged out. Log in again to keep your editions in your account.
sync.problem_rate-limit: Slow down: too many requests. Try again in a minute.
sync.problem_failed: Reaching your account didn't work. Your editions are safe in this browser.
editor.sync_login: You were logged out. Log in again to keep saving to your account; meanwhile everything is in this browser.
editor.sync_rate-limit: Too many requests to your account. It will be tried again soon; meanwhile everything is in this browser.
editor.sync_failed: Saving to your account doesn't work right now. Everything is in this browser.
boxes.too_many_boxes: You've made a lot of links today. Try again tomorrow.
boxes.closed: The maker closed this link. You can't add anything anymore.
boxes.nothing_to_add: Add a photo or a suggestion.
boxes.too_long: That's too long. At most :max characters.
boxes.full: A lot of contributions have come in already. Ask the maker for a new link.
boxes.full_photos: Enough photos have been sent already. Send a suggestion, or ask the maker to make room.
boxes.share_image_failed: Making the picture didn't work. Try again in a moment.
collect.intro: You get a link for the group chat. Friends can use it to send a photo or an idea for a name or card text, no account needed. Only you see what they send, and you choose what goes in.
collect.expires: The link and everything in it disappear on :date if nothing happens. Every contribution extends that.
collect.status_closed: The link is closed. Friends can't add anything anymore.
collect.renew_hint: The old link stops working. What has come in stays.
collect.delete_confirm: Delete all contributions and the link? This can't be undone.
collect.empty: Nothing yet. Put the link in the group chat.
collect.load_failed: Loading the link didn't work. Try again in a moment.
collect.image_body: A picture of the board to send along with the link.
collect.image_failed: Making the picture didn't work. Try again in a moment.
friend.title: Help with :name
friend.lead: Send a photo or an idea for a space, a card or a pawn. The maker picks what goes in. No login needed.
friend.first_name_hint: The maker sees it with your contribution.
friend.pick: Pick a space, card or pawn
friend.step_send: Send a photo or an idea
friend.pick_hint: Tap a space on the board.
friend.name_placeholder: A name from your town, for example
friend.closed_body: The maker isn't taking contributions anymore. Ask in the group whether there's a new link.
friend.privacy: Only the maker sees what you send. It's kept for 30 days at most and nobody else sees your photo.
friend.town_placeholder: A town from your area, for example
photo.wrong_type: This file can't be used: pick a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
photo.too_large: This photo is larger than :mb MB. Pick a smaller version.
photo.too_many_pixels: This photo has more than :mp megapixels. Pick a smaller version.
photo.unreadable: This photo can't be read. Try another one.
photo.storage_full: Your storage is full. Delete a few photos first.

print.title: How do you want to print?
print.intro.printer: Each part says what to order. Untick what you don't want to print.
print.intro.home: Each part says how to print it. Untick what you don't want to print.
print.order.printer.board: Order as a custom vinyl sticker, white, matt laminated, repositionable.
print.order.printer.cards: Order as a card set with its own design per card, 350 gsm matt.
print.order.printer.money: Have it printed at a copy shop on 90 to 120 gsm and cut.
print.order.printer.box_lid: Order as a custom vinyl sticker, matt.
print.order.home.board: Print on full A4 sticker sheets, matt.
print.order.home.cards: Print on both sides of 160 to 200 gsm matt paper, at actual size, flipping on the long edge. Print the alignment test first.
print.order.home.money: Print on plain A4 paper of 90 to 120 gsm.
print.order.home.tokens: Print on 200 gsm, at actual size.
print.order.home.box_lid: Print on a sticker sheet, matt, at actual size.
print.order.calibration: Print this at home and hold the corner space against your board. If it fits, order.
print.spec.printer.board: 4 pieces · 248 × 248 mm each · 3 mm bleed on top
print.spec.printer.money: 210 notes · 15 sheets SRA3 · with crop marks
print.spec.home.board: 7 sheets A4 · every space its own sticker
print.spec.home.cards: :sheets A4 sheets · both sides, 9 cards per sheet · plus alignment test
print.spec.calibration: A4 · ruler, bank card and corner space
print.order.printer.rules_booklet: Have it printed on 120 to 170 gsm and stapled as an A5 booklet.
print.order.printer.fold_models: Print on 160 to 200 gsm paper; you cut and fold them yourself.
print.order.printer.dice: Print on 160 to 200 gsm paper; you cut and fold them yourself.
print.order.printer.invitation: Order as an A6 card, 300 gsm, with 3 mm bleed.
print.order.home.rules_booklet: Print on both sides, flipping on the short edge. Fold the sheets in half and staple them.
print.order.home.fold_models: Print on 160 to 200 gsm paper, then cut and fold.
print.order.home.dice: Print on 160 to 200 gsm paper, then cut and fold.
print.order.home.invitation: Print on 160 to 200 gsm paper and cut along the dashed lines.
print.spec.printer.invitation: 1 A6 card · 3 mm bleed · plus a 1080 px PNG
print.spec.home.invitation: 1 A4 sheet · 4 A6 cards · plus a 1080 px PNG
print.reason.timeout: Making this part took too long. Try again; if that does not help, put fewer photos on one sheet first.
print.reason.photos: One or more photos are missing or could not be read. Pick the photos in the editor again and retry.
print.reason.layout: The PDF did not match the plan for the sheets. Try again.
print.reason.edition: The edition can no longer be read or no longer exists. Open the editor and print again.
print.reason.other: Unknown error. Try again; if it keeps failing, send us a message through the contact page.
print.server_notice: To make the PDFs we send your edition and photos to our server. Only your download link gives access, and we delete them after :days days.
print.close_note: You can close this page. The files stay available for :days days.
print.close_note_anonymous: You can close this page. The files stay available for :days days. Keep this link to find them again.
print.combine_note: You can combine parts from both sets.
print.heading: Print :name
print.trial.title: Try first: test sheet
print.no_edition: There is no edition here. Open the editor first.
print.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
print.error_busy: A run is already going. Wait until it is done.
print.error_throttled: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
print.error_photos: A photo is missing or could not be read. Check the photos in your edition and try again.
editor.layer_hint: Drag a layer to move it. The corner handle makes it bigger or smaller, the round handle turns it.
editor.amount_hint: Paying or receiving stays as it is. The amount is printed at the bottom of the card.
editor.house_rules_hint: One rule per line, the card numbers them for you. Insert adds the name of a space, which changes along when you rename it.
editor.invitation_hint: Date, place and what everyone brings, one per line. Leave it empty and there are dotted lines to fill in by hand.
editor.back_applies: The back applies to all :count cards of this deck.
sample.title: Sample edition
sample.heading: Sample: :name
sample.intro: This is what an edition looks like with a few streets and two cards of its own. You can look around here. Changing things is for your own copy.
sample.failed: The copy did not work. Try again.
editions.lead_empty: The editions you make end up here.
editions.empty_body: Make a first edition, or look at a finished one first.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.lead: You can do all of this without a mouse. They do nothing while you type in a field. Press Esc, or Enter in a one-line field, to go back to the board.
shortcuts.tabs: Go to Board, Cards, Money or Box
shortcuts.rotate: Rotate the photo a quarter turn
shortcuts.grayscale: Black and white on or off
shortcuts.paste: Paste a photo from the clipboard
shortcuts.swap: Swap a space with another of the same kind (with the board focused)
shortcuts.preview: Preview of the whole board and everything
shortcuts.nudge: Move the photo, with the photo frame focused
shortcuts.save: Save (it happens by itself, this just shows it)
shortcuts.plain_hint: Turn this off if you use a screen reader or the letters get in the way. Keys with Ctrl or Cmd keep working.
error.body_404: The page you wanted is not here, or the link has changed.
error.body_403: You are not allowed to open this page.
error.body_419: Reload the page and try again.
error.body_500: That is on us. Try again in a few minutes.
error.body_503: Printopoly is being updated. Try again in a moment.
editor.center_hint_photo: The photo stands above the name, overlapping the edge of the name plate. A PNG with a transparent background (a cut-out figure) looks best; switch the frame off for it.
editor.center_hint_logo: Your logo replaces the name and keeps the shape of your file. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP; a PNG with a transparent background works best. SVG is not supported.
editor.subtitle: Subtitle
editor.background_hint: The card spots show on it as a dotted line, and the name goes on top.
words.preview_buildings: This is how it reads on a title deed: :text
words.corner_text_start: The salary under the name. Type the amount yourself.
editor.style_softened: That colour is brighter than print ink can make. We softened it a little so it doesn't come out dull on paper.
editor.style_accent_hint: The colour of the arrows on the board (Start and Go to jail), of the title on the box lid and of the other accents.
editor.style_groups_hint: Applies to the board and to the title deeds of that group.
editor.icon_hint: A PNG with a see-through background works best.
editor.icon_uploaded: Your own image is on the space.
editor.icon_failed: That image didn't work. Try a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
templates.title: Start from…
templates.hint: A template fills in names, cards and house rules for you. You can change everything afterwards.
templates.blank_tagline: The standard edition. You fill in everything yourself.
sample.template_intro: :tagline Have a look around. You can only change things in your own copy.
editor.amount_show: Show the amount at the bottom of the card
editor.amount_hidden_hint: Turn this off when your own text names the amount itself.
editor.purpose_hint: Follows the amount, like "Pay M50 for your language course". Leave it empty for just the amount.
editor.amounts_hint: Every amount can go 20% up or down. The rent for a full colour group and the cost of paying off a mortgage follow from them.
editor.amount_house_cost: Building cost per house and hotel
editor.board_zoomed_hint: Swipe to move the board and tap a space.
editor.menu_duplicate_failed: Duplicating did not work. Try again.
editor.friends_row_label: {1} From friends, 1 waiting. Go to the first one.|[2,*] From friends, :count waiting. Go to the first one.
editor.board_pick: Enlarge the board to pick a space
editor.bank_moved: The name of the bank is on every note. You change it under Edition, Words.
edition_panel.reset_section: Put this whole section back to standard
edition_panel.subtitle: Subtitle
edition_panel.subtitle_where: in the middle of the board
edition_panel.currency_example: This is how an amount looks on the board: :text
edition_panel.accent_where: arrows, title on the box lid
edition_panel.words_hint: An empty field keeps the standard word. You change the names of the corners and the tax spaces at the space itself.
edition_panel.waiting_hint: Open the space or card to apply or turn down a contribution.
templates.hint_new: A template also picks the theme and the parts. You can change them below.
edition.currency_note: Currency: :currency. It follows the language. You change it later in the editor under Edition, General.
editions.status_box_open: Make it together: link open until :date
editions.status_printer_outdated: Print-shop set is out of date, make it again
editions.status_home_outdated: Home-print set is out of date, make it again
editor.reset_confirm_photo: Everything you changed on :name goes, the photo too. Undo brings it back.
editor.swap_intro: Name, photo and title deed move to the other space. Price and colour belong to the spot and stay.
editor.deck_full: This deck has :count cards. That is the most it can hold.

editor.group_streets_lightblue: applies to all :count light blue streets
editor.group_streets_darkblue: applies to all :count dark blue streets
editor.deck_space_name: This space is named after its deck: :name.
editor.center_logo_text: With a logo there is no name in the centre. The name stays on the box lid.
editor.image_where_rulesBooklet: The photo goes on the cover of the booklet.
editor.image_where_foldModels: The photo goes small on the front of every house and hotel.
editor.image_where_dice: The photo goes on every face of the dice, under the pips.
editor.image_where_note: The photo goes in the oval, behind the value.
editor.image_where_deed: Shows on the space and on the title deed.
editor.photo_hint_keys: You can also drag a photo here or paste one with :keys.
editor.photo_hint_move: Drag the photo in the preview to move it. Arrow keys, plus and minus work too.
editor.layers_center_tag: not on the fold lines and card spots
editor.layer_hint_keys: With the keyboard: arrows move, plus and minus scale, the square brackets turn.
editor.amount_extra_hint: An extra card has no standard amount. Pick an amount up to :max.
editor.note_fixed: The value (:value) and the number (:count) are fixed.
editor.photo_fit_announce_fit: The whole photo is in the frame.
editor.photo_hint_touch: Drag the photo in the preview to move it. Pinch to zoom.
editor.photo_drag_hint: Drag to move, pinch to zoom
editor.photos_undone: Undone: the :count spaces are back as they were.
editor.deed_photo_own: The title deed has a photo of its own. Change it under Title deed.
editor.deed_photo_space_hint: The same photo as on the space. Drag it here and the title deed gets a crop of its own.
editor.deed_story_hint: Goes on the back, under the mortgage. A few lines about the place.
editor.deed_story_placeholder: Grandpa's bakery used to stand here.
editor.lid_lines_hint: Go under the subtitle, such as a date or who the game is for.
